Hello.

There was recently a small update made to the game. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1832380/discussions/0/5156060518444811196/?ctp=3]User Anssy reported a bug[/url] they were encountering that made the game crash when opening treasure chests and such. Whoops.

We've been looking into fixing it, Kalbintion has been very patient with me, and in the process of trying to figure out what on earth was going wrong, might have accidentally solved the issue.

Huh.

Cool.

Well, if what we did works, that's great. However, still more testing to come and let's hope what I did didn't accidentally break the game some more.

Take care everyone~ ːtigerinablanketː

notes.title: Quick Upppppdaaaattte...!
notes.notes:
So. I have been inactive and have missed out on giving you guys virtual hugs. I will briefly remedy that now, as I can see how hard you've been working, and how much you deserve it.

[b]*HUGSPLOSION, JUST FOR YOU!!*[/b]

Anyway, the main reason for this post is I wanted to give you guys a brief update on what I've been doing to make up for my recent silence.

[u][b]>Sequel News[/b][/u]
I've still been puttering away on the sequel, and was thinking of maybe submitting it for Early Access. Don't know what you guys think about that. I originally thought of Early Accessing the game after finishing Quest #5, but Quest #5 ended on a big cliffhanger [i]annnnddd[/i]...wasn't sure if I wanted to end the Early Access version of the game on a big cliffhanger. So I've been writing Quest #6. And Quest #6 is an absolute doozy to write. Right now, I am working on one of the final cutscenes of that quest, which has a lot of branching dialogue options in it. This dialogue tree alone feels like I've been working on it for something like an entire month. I am very tired, and hope it will all be worth it.

[u][b]>What About That Book Thing?[/b][/u]
So, great news! The printed version of my book arrived! Hooray! :D It actually arrived a couple hours after I finished my previous post! Great Valentines Day present, if you ask me!

[u]Problem #1:[/u] So.....................[i]aaaauuuugggghhhh[/i]... Okay, first of all, because of my books very specific dimensions (and the fact that I insisted on two colour pages being printed in the middle of a black and white book), I had to go to a private printing house to get them custom printed. Great. Except Amazon is stupid and won't let me link the books I have with the page I have for the digital copy. If I want to distribute my book with Amazon, I have to pay a $33 per month fee via Amazon's [i]other[/i] service. I can't throw that kind of money around.

[u]Problem #2:[/u] When getting my book printed, I thought of doing everything for the cover...except print the price of the book clearly on the back. Doh. I didn't think this was much of a problem, until I looked on Indigo/Chapters, which said that they wouldn't take new books unless they had the price tag clearly printed on the book. I feel so dumb now. So until I finish selling all of the books I got printed, I can't submit my book to a mainstream bookstore-chain like Indigo/Chapters.

I have no idea how to get these books to you guys. I really want to, as a couple of you seemed interested, but I am so flummoxed by this that I have been putting off telling you guys about it. If any of you know how I could actually go about doing this, I would love to hear it. However, until then, I'm just thinking that maybe I should reach out to you guys via DMs to get your mailing addresses directly, and just mail them. Which, yes, does not seem practical or all that safe in the slightest. Any ideas, guys? Because I'm at a loss. @_@

Otherwise, take care. Really do hope you're doing well. Look forward to hearing from you.

notes.title: Sequel Demo Open for Public Consumption!
notes.notes:
So, there was some weird stuff that happened behind the scenes here, recently. See, in my last post, I asked if I should release the sequel demo either on December 16th or on December 23rd. Wasn't sure which, some people wanted it earlier, some people were okay with it coming out later.

Then I went into the Steam settings and stuff and realized that I could release it immediately! And so I did! The demo has technically been out since December 6th!

..."Technically."

See, while the demo has been out since December 6th, the Steam Store Page for the main application (the full game's App ID) wasn't released publicly yet. So, while the demo has been out for a while, the Steam Store glitched out on me, and refused to give me a link to the demo.

The last few days have been me going back and forth with the Steam Team, getting the Steam Store page up and running.

Long story short, the Steam Store doesn't glitch out on either of us anymore, and now we are all allowed Public access to the demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239960
As you can see, I put that the full game won't be released until 2055. That's because, after how stupidly long it took me to put the revamp back together, I don't realistically see myself being able to complete the game in any reasonable time-frame. I said 2055, but it would surprise me if I actually somehow managed to miss that deadline too.

What can I say? I'm working alone and I'm broke. My games have always been coming out of my pocket, and I have no idea how long it will take me to raise the money I need to make this as shiny as I want it to be.

So what can you do? Um... Play the demo? I dunno. I've never been a social person, so spreading the word might help as well... There's also that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850120/Optional_Additional_Payment_1__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0]Optional[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850121/Optional_Additional_Payment_2__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0]Additional[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850122/Optional_Additional_Payment_3__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0]Payment[/url] System you can use to donate towards my endeavors, if you are so inclined.

Or, you know, if you don't have money, the most effective way you can help me out is by writing a review for the revamp... It doesn't even have to be positive. I need ten reviews in order for the revamp to show up as anything but a neutral score, and over the course of a year, I've barely managed to get five. So consider reviewing it, if you don't want spend anything, but still want the sequel to release before 2055.

Otherwise, yeah. I'm done. I'll keep working on this sequel in the background, but it obviously takes a back-seat to stuff happening in real life, and it won't get a commercial release until I can make everything look as pretty as it does in the revamp.

Until then...um...yeah. Enjoy the demo, I guess.

notes.title: Thirteen U.F.O.s a-Landin' Update
notes.notes:
Oh hey, look. I've been making so many updates that the Twelve Days of Christmas Theme is almost relevant again!

Ahem, uh...right! To business!

I've updated the game once again. Because I can. Some such updates include...
-I've edited and added Drop Shadows to the enemies now! You can see them in battle!
-I've renamed the Etherwhale again, in game. Changed it from "The Ethereal" back to "The Unknown" again. This is because, in the sequel, I'll actually be giving names to the monsters, and calling the "Etherwhale the Ethereal" was just kind of redundant.
-Changed the sleeping animation for the regular wolf. Because the one I had before just looked stupid.
-Did I mention that I added Drop Shadows to the enemies in battle? I did that. It took my programmer a stupid amount of time to write an "Manually Edit Shadows" Plugin, and an even stupider amount of time for me to manually reposition them. It was stupid. So please take the time to appreciate this mundane little detail, even if the Orcs and Ogres look like they're levitating when they die. Thank you.
-And a bunch of other small things that I've either forgotten about or can't be bothered to tell you.

And that should be all! notes.notes:
OKAY, last Maze Alternate Dimension Monster is a GOOOOO!ːsteamhappyː

For starters, we finally have  [url=https://twitter.com/CherryCoStudios/status/1562605815458308096]our last boss monster[/url] for the Alternate Dimension up and ready, and get your feathers and sparkly outfits ready, because this monster is ready to [b]PAR-TAAYYYY![/b] We have...um...the fourth monster, who is a Mardi Gras Inspired, Armoured Phoenix Knight Valkerie Thing! Why did we jumble all those attributes together? I don't know! But what I [i]DO[/i] know is that she looks fabulous and probably one of the best designs so far! So time to get down and party while trying not to singe your eyebrows off!ːsteamsunnyː

Second thing of note is that the game's total file size is significantly smaller than before. That's because, in preparation for the sequel, I moved a whole bunch of maps and images over from the main game, over to sequel land. So, for the first time, I no longer have secret areas designated for my hackers to explore. (So sad. ːsteamsadː)

Third, um, been talking with my programmer guy, and one plugin that my previous programmer guy said was 100% necessary, ended up not being necessary. It was a plugin to help reduce framerate and lag, and my current programmer guy said that the plugin made no substantial difference when he ran the game. So, I got rid of it. THAT BEING SAID, if any of you experience significant lag, PLEASE TELL ME and I'll plop it back in.

Fourth, you can now click on the mushrooms in the Monster Infested Woods! Yaaayyy! Everybody's favourite feature has returned now! :D

Fifth, I tweaked a couple of the maps a bit. So sue me.

Lastly, um...that sequel...uhhh...

Well, to be honest, I was kind of ready to release it before, but now I'm not so sure, so I'm tinkering away at it until I feel comfortable with releasing it.

It's also worth noting that, since this [i]is[/i] the last of the Maze Boss Monsters, and the last of the game's monsters that needed to be replaced, this means that, going forward, there are going to be far fewer updates to the game, in general. So this may be the last time you'll hear from me in a while. :P

...That is all for now. Toodles~ːsteamdanceː

By the way, [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BDWLFHQV?ref_=pe_3052080_397670860]I have a book out![/url] Did you read it? Of course you didn't! One person said the exchange rates for their country (Brazil) made games ridiculously expensive, while another person said that they are currently very broke for the holidays, and would be interested in paying later when they got money. Wow!

So, without further ado, here are the three Optional Additional Payment Options!

Payment #1:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850120/Optional_Additional_Payment_1__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0

Payment #2:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850121/Optional_Additional_Payment_2__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0

Payment #3:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850122/Optional_Additional_Payment_3__The_Albino_Hunter/?beta=0

Enjoy!

(Don't worry if you can't afford it or aren't interested in getting any of them. All they have are a dinky-little game that takes less than two minutes to fully explore. It's not worth the extra time. XD)

notes.title: Optional Additional Payment System: Should I Still Do It?
notes.notes:
So, I mentioned in my last update that I was originally planning on releasing an Optional Additional Payment System for people who didn't like how much the Original Game Cost, and would be able to pay me whatever they wanted. I initially decided against uploading the Optional Additional Payment System since I haven't been able to give everyone free Steam Keys like I had initially hoped for.

In short, I thought it would look tacky if I asked for more money after being unable to give you guys free stuff.

However, some friendly users reached out to me and seemed quite interested in the Optional Additional Payment System. They actually seemed unaware that I hadn't posted it yet, and seemed totally okay if I did.

That begs the question: do you guys think I should go for it anyway? Leave your thoughts below. :3

P.S. During testing, one of the achievements hasn't been working for me. I'll look into it and see if anyone else is having this problem.
